description: Benchmark of the implicit-bilayer method against proteins of known topology, segment tilt and span, the hydrophobicity-threshold explanation of the annotation split, and the positive-inside signature
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df=pd.read_csv("slabfit_robustness.csv")
res=pd.read_csv("ortholog_tm_segments.csv")
tilt=pd.read_csv("segment_tilt.csv")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9)); gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,hspace=0.38,wspace=0.28)

# A. benchmark: crossing count vs known/annotated topology
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
known={"COX7A2":1,"SDHD":3,"TOMM20":1,"MIC10":2,"MIC26":np.nan,"MIC27":np.nan}
order=["COX7A2","SDHD","TOMM20","MIC10","MIC26","MIC27"]
for i,p in enumerate(order):
    v=df[df.protein==p].n_crossings.values
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(v),i)+np.random.default_rng(3).normal(0,0.06,len(v)),v,s=30,
               color="#718096",alpha=0.7)
    med=np.median(v); ax.scatter([i],[med],s=160,marker="_",color="black",lw=2.5)
    if not np.isnan(known[p]): ax.scatter([i],[known[p]],s=90,marker="*",color="#e53e3e",zorder=5)
ax.set_xticks(range(6)); ax.set_xticklabels(order,rotation=20)
ax.set_ylabel("bilayer crossings recovered by the slab fit")
ax.set_yticks(range(0,5))
ax.set_title("A. Benchmark over 3 hydrophobicity scales x 3 thicknesses\n(red star = reference topology; bar = median)",fontsize=10)
ax.text(0.02,0.96,"MIC10 reference = 2 (hairpin, both termini IMS)\nTOMM20 is the method's failure case (0 recovered)",
        transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=7,va="top")

# B. tilt and span of membrane segments
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
cols={"MIC26":"#2b6cb0","MIC27":"#dd6b20","MIC10":"#38a169","SDHD":"#805ad5","COX7A2":"#718096"}
for _,r in tilt.iterrows():
    ax.scatter(r.tilt_deg,r.z_span,s=90,color=cols[r.protein],
               edgecolor="black" if r.protein in ("MIC26","MIC27") else "none")
    ax.annotate(f"{r.protein} {r.segment}",(r.tilt_deg,r.z_span),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords="offset points")
ax.axhline(30,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1); ax.text(20,30.6,"30 A hydrophobic core",fontsize=7,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("tilt from bilayer normal (deg)"); ax.set_ylabel("z span traversed (A)")
ax.set_title("B. MIC26 segments traverse the slab like the\nexperimentally validated controls",fontsize=10)

# C. threshold sweep explaining the annotation split
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
th=np.linspace(-0.5,2.2,100)
grp_lab={"vertebrate_APOO":"vertebrate APOO","reviewed":"reviewed family","insect_ApoO_family":"insect","fungal_ApoO_family":"fungal"}
ax.plot(th,[ (res.TM1_meanKD>=t).mean() for t in th],color="#2b6cb0",lw=2,label="segment 1 called")
ax.plot(th,[ (res.TM2_meanKD>=t).mean() for t in th],color="#38a169",lw=2,label="segment 2 called")
for v,lab,c in [(0.56,"human MIC26 seg2 = 0.56","#2b6cb0"),(1.21,"human MIC27 seg2 = 1.21","#dd6b20")]:
    ax.axvline(v,color=c,ls=":",lw=1.6); ax.text(v+0.02,0.55,lab,rotation=90,fontsize=7,color=c)
ax.axvspan(0.56,1.21,color="#fefcbf",alpha=0.6)
ax.text(0.6,0.08,"any threshold in this band calls\nMIC27 seg2 but drops MIC26 seg2",fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("mean Kyte-Doolittle cut-off applied to the mapped segment")
ax.set_ylabel("fraction of 67 orthologs called")
ax.set_title("C. A single hydrophobicity cut-off reproduces the\nUniProt 1-vs-2 TM split",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)

# D. positive-inside bias
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
prots=["MIC26","MIC27","MIC10"]; turn=[0.57,0.62,0.67]; flank=[1/30,6/30,5/30]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.35
ax.bar(x-w/2,turn,w,color="#805ad5",label="inter-helix turn")
ax.bar(x+w/2,flank,w,color="#cbd5e0",label="flanking 15-residue windows")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(prots)
ax.set_ylabel("K+R per residue")
ax.set_title("D. Positive-inside signature: the turn is basic,\nthe termini flanks are not",fontsize=10)
for i,(t,f) in enumerate(zip(turn,flank)):
    ax.text(i,max(t,f)+0.02,f"bias {t-f:+.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.show()

summ=df.groupby("protein").n_crossings.agg(["median","min","max","count"])
summ["reference_topology"]=[1,2,None,None,1,3]
summ.to_csv("benchmark_summary.csv")
print(summ.to_string())
